run_momentum_retriever_training: run the multi-hop dense retriever training script with configurable batch size and learning rate
run_momentum_retriever_prediction: run the multi-hop dense retriever prediction script to evaluate model performance on test data
run_momentum_retriever_fp16: run the multi-hop dense retriever training with FP16 mixed precision using apex AMP
run_momentum_retriever_distributed: run the multi-hop dense retriever training with distributed data parallel across multiple GPUs
run_momentum_retriever_fever: run the multi-hop dense retriever training or prediction on the FEVER dataset
